# Official Source Excerpts - User Guide

## What This Feature Does

Official Source Excerpts displays locally stored excerpts from official government sources with source name, form/publication/instruction title, available dates, citation link, and review tracking.

The page records review activity. It does not certify that a source is current.

## Who Can Use It

Payroll administrators and prototype testers with access to official source records.

## Required Permissions

- View official source excerpt records.
- Record official source review activity.

## Step-by-Step Use

1. Open **Official Sources**.
2. Review the source name, title, revision date, effective date, retrieved date, and citation link.
3. Read the text marked **Official source excerpt**.
4. Open **Review the full official instructions** for the official source record link.
5. Select **Mark reviewed** to record a review log entry.
6. Confirm the **Last reviewed** date is updated.

## Common Errors

| Error | Cause | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| No official source excerpts have been added | No records exist in the local database | Add official source records through a controlled data load |
| Unable to record review | The source record was removed or the database save failed | Refresh the page and retry |
| Source may need review | Retrieved date or revision date is older than 12 months | Verify the current official source |

## Cautions

- ClearPath Payroll provides software tools for payroll calculation, reporting, and data transmission. It does not provide legal, tax, financial, accounting, payroll compliance, or licensed professional advice.
- User is responsible for verifying applicability.
- Review logging does not automatically mark a source current.
